the pattern. 19; Ex 25:40; 26:30; 39:42,43; 2Ch 3:3; Eze 43:10,11; Heb 8:5 the porch. 1Ki 6:3; 2Ch 3:4; Eze 40:8,9,15,48,49 the houses. 1Ki 6:16-20; 2Ch 3:5-10; Eze 41:13-17; Heb 9:2-8 the treasuries.[gnzkyw,] {ganzakkaiv:} the word [gnzk,] {ganzach,} is supposed to be not Hebrew, but Persian; in which language we have [gng,] {ganj,} a granary, a hidden treasure, and [gngwr,] {gunjoor,} and [gngynh,] {gunjineh,} a treasure, treasury, or barn. It may, however, be a Chaldee form of the Hebrew [gnz,] {genez,} (from [gnz,] {genaz,} to treasure up;) the [k] being merely formative, as in [dk,] {dech,} ['lk,] {illaich,} and other Chaldee words.
